anchors.description: Left of the two slatted wooden benches placed end to end in the foreground; length measured between the visible left board end and the butt joint with the right bench.
anchors.visible_evidence: Slatted pine top with black folding steel legs, the classic German folding beer-garden bench (Klappbank/Bierbank); both top-board ends are crisp in the frame and the two bench halves are butted end to end at x~695.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Folding benches of this type are usually 180 cm, sometimes 200 cm; the bench depth is foreshortened, so the length relies on the product-size prior; end points placed on visible board ends (+/-3 px).

anchors.description: Right of the two slatted wooden benches in the foreground; length measured from the butt joint at x~700 to the visible rounded right board end.
anchors.visible_evidence: Same product as the left bench (identical slat pattern, bolt heads and black folding legs); the wooden top runs from the joint behind the green cloth to a rounded end at the right, with the leg frame set in from that end.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Right end is partly behind a green cloth draped over the bench, so the last ~5 cm of board next to the cloth is inferred; length prior 180 cm (200 cm variant possible).
